# ractermx_organization (Resource)

Manages a RacterMX organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a child organization for team-based domain management.
resource "ractermx_organization" "engineering" {
  name      = "Engineering"
  parent_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the organization.
- `parent_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the parent organization.

### Read-Only

- `domains_count` (Number) The number of domains directly in this organization.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the organization.
- `total_domains_count` (Number) The total number of domains including child organizations.
- `users_count` (Number) The number of users in this organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an organization using its numeric ID.
terraform import ractermx_organization.engineering 789
```
